observations.contract: Guide count and rejected product suspicion
observations.trace: Hairdo.guide_count returns only 110, 140 or 160 on its three branches. record_guide_roots multiplies that selected value by40, at most6400, so the previously questioned wanted*40 cannot overflow on this inspected producer. The separate wanted+boundary u32 addition still depends on scalp boundary cardinality.
observations.remaining: This rejects only the selected multiplication suspicion; extremely large scalp boundary production, upload limits, and the separate addition remain conditional and unexecuted.

observations.contract: Maximum guide path and shader offset
observations.trace: Haircut public f32 lengths feed longest_guide and then ceil(longest/0.002) as u32, max301, plus2. With a directly supplied infinite top length and finite zero variation, the floating cast saturates to u32::MAX before that addition. The guide shader separately forms g*hairdo.max_path in u32 for an index, while host path storage is sized in u64.
observations.remaining: Original delegate752 explicitly noted the conditional max_path issue. Whether nonfinite or enormous inputs are admitted and whether earlier GPU stages or allocations fail remains open. The host increment and shader multiplication are distinct first operations; no GPU or product ran.

observations.trace: For non-bun tied styles, Tied::new repeatedly increments f32 s by0.002 while s<Haircut.longest(). At s=65536, f32 spacing is 1/128 and half spacing is1/256; a0.002 increment is less than half and rounds back to the same value under standard round-to-nearest.
observations.remaining: This is symbolic progress reasoning, not a claim that a normal haircut reaches that state. Very large length, earlier resource exhaustion, actual supported bounds and any earlier GPU error remain open. No loop was executed.

observations.trace: upload_guides takes public Strands, resamples them, then indexes attributes and root using length from root_uv. Strands fields are public; matching resample point counts cause a clone before those indexes, with no aggregate shape check in the inspected code.
observations.remaining: Original q379 and delegate760 already named independent parallel-array extents; this traces its selected GPU-guide caller but does not prove an ordinary malformed producer. No GPU upload or index executed.

observations.contract: Packed source order and optional modes
observations.trace: Static source comparison expands the Rust HairdoGpu three-float arrays into scalar components and finds 65 scalar names and primitive types in the same order as the shader Hairdo record. Packed first two whorls come from canonical Follicles.field, which creates at most two; absent tie uses two zero axis slots and an explicit tied flag.
observations.remaining: This is a bounded source-order comparison, not native layout, offset or GPU validation. Original delegate752 identified the deliberate optional defaults and correct canonical whorl bound. No shader parsed or ran.
